questions.prompt: How do you read the `PATH` environment variable in C#?
options: `Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH")`
`Console.ReadLine("PATH")`
`AppContext.GetData("PATH")`
`File.ReadAllText("PATH")`
questions.explanation: Environment variables are accessed through the `System.Environment` class; `GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH")` returns its value.

questions.prompt: Is `Properties/launchSettings.json` used when the app runs in production?
options: Yes; it is the main runtime configuration file
Yes, but only for web projects
No; it is a developer-only file for launching the project locally (debugging or `dotnet run --launch-profile`)
Only when `launchBrowser` is `true`
questions.explanation: `launchSettings.json` configures how the project is launched during local development. It is not part of the app's runtime config in production; treat it as a dev convenience.

questions.prompt: A profile's `environmentVariables` sets `App__MaxItemsPerRun`. Which configuration key does it map to?
options: `App__MaxItemsPerRun` exactly, with the underscores
`App.MaxItemsPerRun`
`App_MaxItemsPerRun`
`App:MaxItemsPerRun`, because a double underscore maps to a colon
questions.explanation: In environment variables, a double underscore maps to the colon used in configuration keys, so `App__MaxItemsPerRun` becomes `App:MaxItemsPerRun`.

questions.prompt: What does `"commandName": "Project"` mean in a launch profile?
options: Launch Visual Studio's IIS Express
Run the project itself, like `dotnet run`
Run an external executable with arguments
Launch the app in a Docker container
questions.explanation: `commandName` sets the type of launch: `Project` runs the project (`dotnet run` behavior), `IISExpress` uses IIS Express, `Executable` runs an external executable and `Docker` launches a container.

questions.prompt: In the `MyWebApp` profile, what does `"applicationUrl": "https://localhost:5001;http://localhost:5000"` control?
options: The page opened in the browser after launch
The URLs Kestrel binds to for the web project
The address of the database server
The IIS Express SSL port
questions.explanation: For web projects, `applicationUrl` is the URL(s) Kestrel will bind to. The page opened in the browser is `launchUrl`, and IIS Express ports live in `iisSettings`.
